body.x: BRAVEN(www.braven.com) unveiled ‘BRV-X’ mobile outdoor bluetooth speaker at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

BRV-X is a mobile bluetooth speaker with 5200mAh built-in battery which lasts more than 12 hours. Speaker is chargeable via USB to charge smartphone or other devices. It operates within 10 meters as the ordinary bluetooth devices do.
It has acquired I-PX5 certification, and is shock-resistant to rain or snow surrounded by rubber.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
